scripts.dev: npm run db:generate && npm run build -w @medilab/shared && npm run build -w @medilab/db && concurrently -n api,worker,web "npm run dev -w @medilab/api" "npm run dev:worker -w @medilab/api" "npm run dev -w @medilab/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @medilab/shared && npm run build -w @medilab/db && npm run build -w @medilab/api && npm run build -w @medilab/web && npm run build -w @medilab/desktop
scripts.prepare:prod: npm run db:generate && npm run db:push && npm run build
scripts.start:prod: npm run db:generate && concurrently -n api,worker "npm run start -w @medilab/api" "npm run start:worker -w @medilab/api"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @medilab/shared && npm run typecheck -w @medilab/db && npm run typecheck -w @medilab/api && npm run typecheck -w @medilab/web && npm run typecheck -w @medilab/desktop
scripts.desktop:dist: npm run desktop:build && npm run dist -w @medilab/desktop
scripts.db:reset: node scripts/prisma-safe.mjs db push --schema packages/db/prisma/schema.postgres.prisma --force-reset --skip-generate && npm run db:generate && npm run db:seed
scripts.db:reset:sqlite: node scripts/prisma-safe.mjs db push --schema packages/db/prisma/sqlite/schema.prisma --force-reset --skip-generate && npm run db:generate:sqlite && npm run db:seed
scripts.postinstall: npm run db:generate && npm run build -w @medilab/shared && npm run build -w @medilab/db
